Who has arrived in this spaceship? Find out here.

videos.title: The Uninvited Guest
videos.overview: Varsha's mother has come down to earth from the alien planet in the disguise of Urvashi Dholakia, a tv actress. The Ghotala family is not aware of the arrival of their granny and big circle of errors begins in the colony. How will the Ghotala's save themselves?

videos.title: Alien On Earth
videos.overview: The sangeet ceremony begins and the Ghotala family are still trying to get in touch with the Alien who has arrived on earth. Meanwhile, Urvashi is finding her way to the Sunshine colony and gets in a tiff with a few goons on the street. Pritesh is informed by his scientist friend that a spaceship has landed on earth and Pritesh gets him to work for the same. Will Pritesh find out the truth of the Ghotala family?

videos.title: Mana'sik Taraang
videos.overview: Hemant reveals that it is his Nani who has come to earth. Vasant is upset with this while Varsha is extremely happy. Urvashi is showing her superpowers to humans on the street and everyone is mistaking her for actress Urvashi. Sharad contacts her and gets her home.

videos.title: Mother Trouble
videos.overview: Urvashi is giving a hard time to Vasant when Bhairavi steps in. They are trying to hide her from Bhairavi but she reveals herself and with her powers learn the Gujarati language. Meanwhile, Anna comes to talk to Manav but instead of Manav, Sharad is sleeping. The Sunshine colony witnesses 2 new guests. Who are they? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: The Unexpected Guests
videos.overview: Abhishek Bachchan and Rishi Kapoor come to the Ghotala house to use the restroom. Meanwhile, Ratna Pathak Shah reaches the Bhatt house. Urvashi puts chutney on her face thinking it's Haldi. She reaches Ronnie's house and with her powers learns his way of talking while Vasant is busy looking for her.

videos.title: Mother In Laws Reality
videos.overview: Bhavna confronts Vasant saying that she is Urvashi Dholakia but Vasant declines. As things go in progression Vasant's mother-in-law descents in the living room. Urvashi challenges Vasant that she will never let her daughter Varsha get married to Vasant again and Vasant challenges her back saying that he will mary Varsha come what may. Who will win this challenge? Urvashi or Vasant? Find out in this episode.

videos.title: Vasant & Varsha's Marriage
videos.overview: Bhairavi and Hemant are dancing on the eve of Vasant and Varsha's marriage as their dance show gets the momentum. Bhavna calls Bhairavi to enquire about the lost nose ring of Bhavna for which she asked Bhairavi to organize a search. Meanwhile, Vasant is preparing for his wedding and his neighbours are helping him in the same. Can Bhairavi find her mother-in-law's nose ring? How this wedding of Vasant and Varsha will turn out?

videos.title: Mystery Of Varsha's Disappearance
videos.overview: Vasant enquires about Varsha when the wedding ceremony is going on. Urvashi has devised a plan along with Pritesh to stop Varsha and Vasant's marriage. Lajjo comes looking for Varsha but Varsha is missing. Where is Varsha? Is this a new plan by Urvashi?

videos.title: Truth Behind Varsha's Disappearance
videos.overview: Vasant Hemant and Sharad find out that Varsha is been in the dustbin and is unable to get back to her original size due to lack of sunlight absorption. Everyone at the venue is waiting for Varsha and Vasant. Will she get back to her original form?

videos.title: Shaadi Ka Drama
videos.overview: Varsha and her mother are engaged in a fight and Varsha wants her to leave and go back home. Vasant then interferes and calms them down so that they can go back and perform the marriage rituals. Can Varsha forgive her mother? Will Vasant and Varsha finally get married?

videos.title: Bhairavi Ka Dukh
videos.overview: Urvashi goes back to her planet and Vasant and Varsha celebrate the post-wedding ceremony. Bhavna and Bhairavi get into their regular tiff where Bhavna shouts at Bhairavi and in return depressed Bhairavi takes shelter at Ghotala house.

videos.title: Bhavna Ka Mangalsutra
videos.overview: Bhavna and  Bhairavi go out for some shopping to the market. Petty thieves strike and manage to snatch Bhairavi's mangalsutra. They are distraught by the event but just then Vasant uses his supernatural powers and gets the mangalsutra back. Unfortunately for them the goons find out about his supernatural powers.

videos.title: Bhairavi Ka Apaharan
videos.overview: The goons rush back to their boss and inform him about the supernatural powers. They are convinced that Bhairavi has these powers which they can use to their own advantage and amass wealth.The boss orders his goons to kidnap Bhairavi. Bhairavi is kidnapped and she is taken to the boss's house.

videos.title: Ghotala Family's Secrets
videos.overview: Bhairavi is abducted by the goons and their boss forces Bhairavi to showcase the super power which they think she has. A baffled Bhairavi is totatlly unaware of what is being asked from her. Meanwhile,the colony members have called for police for finding out Bhairavi's whereabouts and police suspects its Ghotala's as they were very nervous during the interrogation.

videos.title: Ransom Accepted
videos.overview: Ghotala's go to Rameshbhai and deonstrate to him their superpowers. Rameshbhai tells Ghotala's that  Bhairavi would be set free if they would get him the jewels from Babulal jewellers. Ghotala's are ready to abide by the offer placed by Rameshbhai and agree to get them the booty from the jewellery shop.

videos.title: Transformation Troubles
videos.overview: A comic confusion unfolds. Sharad has transformed himself as Bhairavi and is facing a tough time as Bhadresh is in a romantic mood!  Meanwhile Bhairavi gives a tough time to Ramesh and his wife. On the other hand Vasant, Varsha and Hemant have to quickly think of an idea to save Sharad.

videos.title: Aliens' Ransom Plans
videos.overview: Aliens are now thinking and plotting of various ideas to break into  the jewellery shop. Just then Sharad returns back to their house. However, Vasant sends him back so that he can transform himself into Bhairavi and figure out a plan to avoid Bhadresh.

videos.title: The Robbery
videos.overview: In this episode Sharad comes up with an excuse to avoid Bhadresh. Meanwhile Bhairavi manages to give everybody the slip and flees from Ramesh house the next morning. In the meanwhile Vasant, Varsha and Hemant leave the colony to rob the jewellery shop.

videos.title: Bhairavi Returns Home
videos.overview: In this episode a very unfortunate coincidence happens. Ghotala's are at the jewellery shop and in a very naive manner ask for all the jewels of the shop. Meanwhie Bhadresh and Murli too reach the jewellery shop following Ghotala. At this very moment it so happens that actual robbers land up  at the jewellery shop!!

videos.title: Sharad Finally Gets Freedom
videos.overview: Bhavna is completely confused and is having a tough time in understanding what is happening at her home because of two Bhairavi's . She starts suspecting that something fishy is happening and begins asking Bhairavi a lot of questions about her activities so that she can arrive at the truth.

videos.title: Police Released Ghotala Family
videos.overview: In this episode everyone confuses the other with their activity. The police too is competely baffled. Ghotala along with Murli, Bhadresh, Ramesh, Mrudula are all summoned to the police station. Very soon Bhairavi too is called for interrogation.

videos.title: Hemant's Search For Baal Krishna
videos.overview: The police station beomes the venue of all confusion where questions, counter questions and clarifications all get muddled up. Bhairavi along with Bhavna and Ila too arrive at the Police station and after much ado Ghotala's are finally declared innocent,  They use the victory as an opportunity to celebrate a belated Rakshabandhan.

videos.title: Nakli Railway Station
videos.overview: In this episode Hemant swears that he will get the blessings of Lord BalKrishna for his sister Bhairavi as a gift of rakshabandhan. He starts implementing on it immediately and uses all the means he has at his disposal. Needless to add, he gets the Ghotala family and all the colony members in a perplexed situation.

videos.title: Hemant's Desire to Meet Krishna
videos.overview: Hemant reaches the railway station and Ghotala family too land up there looking for him A big confusion is created between Hemant and the Ghotala family. Finally the manager of the studio advises Hemant to go to Mumbai Central to catch a train for Ahmedabad.

videos.title: Hemant Gets Krishna's Blessings
videos.overview: In this episode, after a lot of confusion Hemant is united back with Ghotala family. Everybody is in a happy frame of mind. Festivities and celebrations start and all begin to observe janmashtami in the form of performance of Dashavataar of Vishnu.

videos.title: Murli's Birthday Gift
videos.overview: As the Janmashtami celebrations are on every one joins in for performing Dashavataar of Vishnu. To add fun to the proceedings, all the colony members frighten Ojha by scaring him as goons and give him a wonderful birthday surprise at midnight.

videos.title: Vasant's Search For Painting Shop
videos.overview: As Ojha's birthday celebrations are on he declares that he will give a "sone ka gift"  to the one who gifts him a wonderful thing on his birthday. Expecting a gold item, all  colony members get into the hunt for best gift for Ojha.

videos.title: Ghotalas Gift For Murli
videos.overview: As everyone is busy trying to impress Ojha and try to get the best gift, the Ghotala's  somehow manage to get a wonderful painting as a birthday gift for Ojha after creating a few blunders. Ojha comically upstages everyone by announcing that he has a pillow as "sone ki gift " !!

videos.title: Vasant Forgets Lord Ganesha's Idol
videos.overview: In this episode we see a very hilarious and unique situation evolving. All the ladies of the group want to impress their husbands and go to a beauty parlour and return with new hair cuts and beauty treatments. However, their efforts go waste as it goes completely unnoticed by their husbands, especially Vasant!!

videos.title: Vasant Eager to Meet Barkha
videos.overview: Varsha, disappointed by the way her husband Vasant has behaved tells her sorrow to the women of the colony and Anna comes up with an idea. Vasant recieves a flirtatious call from an unknown lady Barkha. She desires to meet him and Vasant agrees for the same!

videos.title: Vasant Mistook Varsha For Barkha
videos.overview: In this episode, Varsha comes to meet Vasant as Barkha as all the ladies have given her a makeover. Vasant starts flirting with Barkha unknowingly and Varsha gives him back. Finally, Vasant patches up with her.

videos.title: Tussle For Ganesha's Idol
videos.overview: In this episode we see Sharad select a Ganapati idol that  Anna had liked. They are unaware of the fact that it had already been shortlisted by Vidya Mandodre. All colony members are scared of the consequences as they are fully aware that Vidya is very stubborn and will react adversely.

videos.title: Ganesh Murti Laane Ki Zidd
videos.overview: As expected, the showdown happens in this episode. Vidya gives a threatning call to the colony members. Despite attempts to reconcile, both Sharad and Vidya remain adamant that they will not change their selection. The water supply to the colony is cut and all the  members face a tough time.

videos.title: Vidya Tortures Sunshine Residents
videos.overview: In this episode too the showdown continues and in fact becomes worse. The water and even the gas supply in the colony is cut off.  All the colony members try to convince Sharad but Manav finds that whatever Sharad is standing for is right. The entire colony decides to stand by Sharad

videos.title: Protest Against Vidya Mandodari
videos.overview: In this episode the Aliens family comes to rescue and diffuse the crisis. They arrange water and food for the colony members all participate to have some fun and light a camp fire. While everyone is having dinner,  Manav comes up with an idea to give Vidya a hard time.

videos.title: End Of Women Protest
videos.overview: All the males of sunshine colony sneak into Vidya's house for a bath while the ladies  order food for entire colony and bill it on Vidya. On learning this Vidya takes a vow to not let the colony people take the Ganesh idol to their colony. The next day all are shocked to see their ouses being locked by hired goons of Vidya.

videos.title: Sunshine Colony Celebrates Ganesha Chaturthi
videos.overview: A mega showdown unfolds between a stubborn Vidya and the members of the colony. Even as she and her goons prevent the Ganesha idol being taken Vidya suffers from an asthama attack. The good samaritans of the colony take her to the doctor and save her life. Vidya realizes her folly and reaches an amicable settlement with the Sunshine Colony.

videos.title: Kaam Wali Bai
videos.overview: Bhadresh,Ronnie and Ojha feel that their life has no excitement. They come to the conclusion that the only way to add spice in their life is to take a break  from their regular boring lifestyle. They decide that fun can come back only if they manage to get back to their bachelor phase of life. They start planning it.

videos.title: Bhavna Left Her Home
videos.overview: In this episode the three musketeers - Bhadresh, Ronnie and Ojha elaborate their plans. They start convincing all the ladies of their family to switch family members to maximise the fun. The ladies too agree to the hilarious idea and the fun unfolds.

videos.title: Bhavna In Ghotala Residence
videos.overview: Bhavna gives a tough time to the Ghotala's family. Lajo meanwhile faces a tough time with Bhairavi. On the other hand the "The three musketeers" are lost in the dream world of their fantasies as they have now hired a maid for the seven days as domestic help.

videos.title: Housekeeping Staff Ramya
videos.overview: In this episode we see Bhavna making Varsha and Vasant work very hard on the daily chores. She however is all praise for Hemant for his perfect work. Hemant gets excited and eats three multiplier pills and turns himself into a nine year old.

videos.title: Old & Weak Ramya
videos.overview: In this episode we are taken through all the difficulties that the family members go through to get  Hemant back to normal which finally happens to the relief of everybody. The three musketeers too come back from their fantasy land and get rid of the  maid bringing back a sense of normalcy.

videos.title: Eight Avatars Of Hemant
videos.overview: Sharad is disturbed due to the good chemistry that develops between Manav and  Anna. He tries his level best to disturb them and also succeeds in his task. We also see that the experiment of switching families has had a adverse effect on colony members and all are sitting in the colony compound in distress.

videos.title: Bhadresh's Smart Plan
videos.overview: In this episode we finally see the realization seep in that the entire idea of switching families was a wrong one and does not lead to happiness at all. The colony members unite with their families and agree on the old  saying that "Home is where the heart is"

videos.title: Reunion Of Bhavna and Bhairavi
videos.overview: There is a suspicious creature moving about in the colony. All happen to notice the strange movements but are unable to conclude as to what exactly it is. The rumours gather speed and very soon the news spreads around that an alien has been sighted. All colony members now start to panick.

videos.title: Alien On Earth
videos.overview: The news of an Alien being sighted has spread a panick in the colony. Pritesh and his scientist friend come up with special kind of glasses which when worn can enable one to spot the Alien. Pritesh convinces the males of the colony to experiment with the glasses in the presence of Ghotala family.

videos.title: Alien Creates Chaos
videos.overview: All the males along with the kids go to Ghotala house and obviously the aliens are apprehensive that people should wear glasses in their presence. Others however are slightly surprised with their strange behaviour. Vasant is in a fix . Meanwhile we see Urvashi entering the Ghotala house but others are unaware of this.

videos.title: Alien Recognizing Sunglasses
videos.overview: There is a mix-up of glasses because of Bhairavi. Ghotala's  are now in a panic  and are sure that Bhairavi has identified Hemant as an alien after wearing the glasses. Sharad and Vasant proceed towards them when Bhavna enters the colony along Bhairavi and Hemant.

videos.title: Return Of 555
videos.overview: In this episode the women folk of the entire colony are excited and beaming with happiness at the thought of celbrating navratri. But typically the males of the colony are engrossed with the cricket matches. The women however begin their preparations in all earnestness for the navratri event.

videos.title: Family Navaratri Competition
videos.overview: The ladies cut the connection of TV of their homes to prevent the men from watching cricket. This forces Ojha,Bhadresh and Ronnie to go to Ghotala's house to watch the match. Here they find Vasant, wearing a ghaghra teaching Urvashi how to play garba. Urvashi embarasses Vasant in front of all the males of the colony.

videos.title: Navaratri Celebration
videos.overview: The barrier between cricket lovers and Garba dancers is broken when Manav declares a  prize of Rs 50,000/- for the best dancer. Ronnie, Ojha and Bhadresh  start practicing garba with the women of their family. Navratri competition takes place and all families participate in the fun and frolic.

videos.title: Vasant's Grumpy Mother In Law
videos.overview: Nani had promised that she would leave after navratri but does not do so and comes up with an excuse. This irritates others. Meanwhile, Sharad talks about his pain to Manav and Anna consoles him. This extra attention which Sharad gets disturbs Manav and he gets into a complaining mode.

videos.title: Vasant Gets Tortured
videos.overview: In this episode we find everyone giving others a bad time. Lajo is seen comparing Ojha's temper with a typical mother-in-law which hurts his ego. Nani on the other hand is giving Vasant a tough time and portrays Vasant as a culprit in front of Varsha.

videos.title: Bhavna's Juice Corner
videos.overview: All the menfolk and especially Ojha, Vasant and Bhadresh are now tired with daily nagging of women of their families. They want to emerge out of this vicious circle of allegations, counter allegations and misunderstandings. Ronnie and Lisa come up with  an idea and convince them that it is going to work.

videos.title: Bhadresh Employs Murli & Vasant
videos.overview: Murli and Vasant  decide to start a bussiness venture. They hit upon the idea of selling juice at a joggers park. Here they come accross a customer who claims to be an expert in face reading. He tells Murli that very soon he will find love in his life.

videos.title: Murli's Love Horoscope
videos.overview: Vasant, Bhadresh and Uncle Ojha visit Ronnie after a hard day's work. Ojha had been very quiet since he enters the hour. On pressurizing, Ojha finally reveals that he was told by a fortuneteller that he will find new love in his life and he is very excited about it. The rest of the family are practicing for Diwali's fashion show and are completely determined to win the event.

videos.title: Love At First Sight
videos.overview: Vasant and Ojha find out that there is a shoot set up near their juice shop for the day and are happy that the sales would be good today. Soon after, the beautiful actress, Toffee, comes to the shop for some juice and begins a series of back and forth flirting. Bhadresh tries to prove Mr. Yadav wrong, by helping him sell mattresses while using his best selling strategy.

videos.title: Murli's Love Story
videos.overview: Uncle Ojha's flirting continues with the actress, Toffee, as she calls him to have lunch with her. At the same time, Lajo sends some lunch for Murlidhar. Ojha finds out about the actress' diet and their story progresses.

videos.title: Oh Just Fantasy
videos.overview: In this episode we find Ojha fantasizing about his love life with Toffee along with Lajo and Manav. He even dreams about Lajo and Toffe both celeberating karwa chauth together. Ojha is convinced that there is a full on romance happening between him and Toffee.

videos.title: Nani The Prankster
videos.overview: In this episode Ojha's fantasies and dream world get a further boost whenToffee asks him for a night out at Panvel . Meanwhile, Nani gives Vasant a tough time by playing pranks on him. Ojha on the other hand is in his dream world and is super excited by the thought of spending a night at Panvel with Toffee.

videos.title: Ojha Caught
videos.overview: Manav is now made aware of his father's new found fantasy. He is deeply shocked to learn that his father has fallen in love at this age. He insists on hearing the same from Toffe also. Ojha asks Urvashi to inform Lajo about the same.

videos.title: Toffee's Story
videos.overview: Toffee confesses to Ojha that he resembles her late father a lot and that was the only reason why she was attracted towards him. Ojha becomes a laughing stock in front of his friends but Manav understands his fathers emotions and handles the situation very well keeping Lajo unaware of the entire incident.

videos.title: Bhadresh Apologizes to Bhavna
videos.overview: In this episode we see Manav continue to behave in a very matured way and manages to re-kindle romance amongst his parents. However, his personal love life takes an adverse turn as Anna gets upset over a minor issue and is bugged with Manav and Sharad.

videos.title: Planning For Liza's Birthday
videos.overview: Lisa and Ronnie declare that its Lisa's 40th birthday party.  Anna decides to make it a grand event. The theme of the party is traditional wear and all the guests are supposed to dress up in traditional outfits. The members of Sunshine colony begin their dress reherasal for the grand party.

videos.title: Alien Roop
videos.overview: Nani is busy asking everyone as to what she should wear for the party. All advise her to wear the traditional dress of the place she has come from. Varsha manages to get Nani home when the alien detector starts blinking. Hemant, Varsha and Nani run outside in the dark in search of their lost son much to the surprise of the colony members.

videos.title: A Competition
videos.overview: Hemant returns late night alone when all the colony members question him. The next morning Bhadresh suspects the Ghotala family and to prove their innoocence Nani performs alien tricks in front of the Sunshine colony and then covers it up by saying she was a trapeze artist in Suryanagar. The Ghotala family is hence proved innocent.

videos.title: Venue For Liza's Birthday Party
videos.overview: In this episode Nani takes Anna and Sharad to an empty bungalow in the pretext of taking a look at the venue of the party. Ronnie, Lisa and all others are worried as Anna is not in the colony and cannot be traced. Sharad informs Anna that they have been deliberately locked up in the empty bungalow.

videos.title: Anna Stuck With Sharad
videos.overview: Anna is worried as its dark and she is lockd in the bunglow with Sharad. The entire colony is worried as Anna is missing and its getting dark. Sharad on the other hand recollects the tactic taught by Nani and Hemant to get closer to Anna. Vasant is tensed and asks Nani about Sharad and Anna but Nani is adamant and remains mum.

videos.title: Anna Impressed By Sharad
videos.overview: Sharad gets some eatables for Anna and hurts himself. Anna masagges his leg and falls asleep. Ronnie goes and gets Anna and Sharad back and Anna says that Sharad is a gem of a person. Nani explains Sharad that after all he is an alien and he and Anna would not be a good match. Sharad agrees and says that he will have a talk with Anna accordingly.

videos.title: Anna Ki Shaadi
videos.overview: Ojha gets Manav's alliance for Anna but she tries to postpone things and says that she needs some time to think. Bhairavi informs about it to Sharad who understands the real reason behind it. He asks Anna to go ahead and have a happy life with Manav. He breaks up with Anna and kills the feelings he had nurtured for her.

videos.title: Friends Again
videos.overview: Manav tells Anna that she will have to change her religion if she wishes to marry him. Anna rejects his proposal at that very instant only later to learn that Manav was only trying to help Anna to get a clear vision on who she would choose as a partner him or Sharad. Meanwhile, Jacky a new tenant comes to the Colony. The alien detector app blinks brightly on his arrival but goes unnoticed by the Ghotala's.

videos.title: Jackie The Alien
videos.overview: Jacky is introduced to all the colony members by Anna and she invites him to Lisa's party. Jacky visits the Ghotala's when they are dressed in tribal clothes. Varsha develops a special liking towards him. Jacky leaves the party abruptly as he starts feeling his superpower going out of control.

videos.title: Suryanagar Ki Recipe
videos.overview: In this episode we see that because of fluctuation of power the aliens are forced to leave Lisa's birthday party abruptly. They give lame excuses for leaving so soon. This provokes Bhadresh to ponder over their behaviour which looks quite abnormal.

videos.title: Galat Doctor
videos.overview: Bhadresh, the good samaritan that he is, takes a doctor along with him to check the Ghotala's. They had all developed high fever immediately after the party which again does not seem to be a normal thing to the colony members. Nani thinks of an idea to stop being suspected.

videos.title: Bhuse Ki Roti
videos.overview: Nani and Hemant spike the drinks of colony members which makes the normal humans display super powers. Except the Ghotala's, all are now behaving in a different way and the entire situation is a bizzare as nobody has a clue as to what is the reason behind this.

videos.title: Formula 070
videos.overview: In this episode Vasant comes to know that Nani and Hemant had spiked the drinks hence this bizarre behaviour by everyone. He decides that as soon as possible he should go ahead in search of their lost son. He calls for a special time machine for this purpose.

videos.title: Time Machine
videos.overview: Pritesh suspects Hemant to have spiked the drink of the colony members. They all get together and discuss about the matter. Meanwhile the Ghotala family is about to leave in search of their son leaving Nani behind as the machine can carry only five people.

videos.title: Paanch Saal Pehle
videos.overview: A huge goof up is committed by Hemant. The Time machine, that was scheduled to leave for 2010, takes them 5200 years behind as Hemant presses the wrong buttons. To make matters even more complicated, Vasant discovers that Bhairavi has accompanied them in the time machine by mistake and panicks for the same.

videos.title: Time Travel
videos.overview: The time machine now dutifully goes back by 5200 years and the Ghotala's are transported to very strange surroundings. As they alight from time machine they discover that they have landed in Gokulnagari in the era when Lord Krishna was alive in human form.

videos.title: Ghotalas In Gokulnagari
videos.overview: In this episode we see that Lord Krishna meets the Ghotala's. He finds them pure at heart and grows fond of them. Meanwhile there is panic in the Sunshine colony as Bhairavi is missing and nobody has a clue as to why she has gone missing.

videos.title: Ghotalas Mistaken For Demons
videos.overview: Vasant finally tells Lord Krishna that they are in the midst of a huge confusion and need his help urgently. Lord Krishna in return tells them that he will help them provided they agree to participate in his leela. The Ghotala's have no option but be part of the Krishna leela.

videos.title: Kanha's Lesson For Ghotalas
videos.overview: In this hilarious episode Vasant and Hemant help Krishna to steal makhan from a house. Yashoda catches them red handed and Kanha puts the entire blame on Vasant. They move from there in search of the pigment to charge the Time machine where Brahma appears!!

videos.title: Divine Play Of Krishna
videos.overview: In this episode we see Lord Krishna helping out the Ghotala's. He shows his viraat swaroop to the aliens. Finally, they find the pigment to charge the time machine. However, it starts raining heavily posing further hurdles.

videos.title: Time to Leave Gokulnagari
videos.overview: With the help of Lord Krishna they surmount all their problems. Govardhan parvat leela is performed and the Ghotala's  manage to get into the time machine. After a lot of twists and turns they return to their actual time.

videos.title: Reality Of Jackie
videos.overview: Meanwhile back in the colony everyone is now deeply worried. People in general, start suspecting Jacky to be the real culprit behind the disappearance of Bhairavi.  However, very soon the confusion is over as the aliens reach to their current time zone along with Bhairavi.

videos.title: Ghotalas Return to 2015
videos.overview: All reach in their real time and not only that God, it seems, has adjusted the time zone to previous night. Oblivious of everything, all are enjoying Lisa's birthday party. Vasant expresses his gratitude to paththarwale bhagwan.

videos.title: Whereabouts Of 2015
videos.overview: In this episode finally the Ghotala's notice that the alien detector machine shines on the entry of Jacky. They are now sure that he too is an alien. On interrogating him they realise that their son was a friend of Jacky. They once again begin their search for their lost son in right earnest.

videos.title: Reality Of Manav
videos.overview: Jacky shows the pic of his friend to Ghotala family. They become emotional as they see a ray of hope of finding their lost son. They start asking more questions about him to Jacky and learn that their lost son now works as a supervisor in a sports shop.

videos.title: Search For Mysterious Shop Boy
videos.overview: Ghotala's visit the sports shop where they think they would get to know the wehereabouts of their lost son. To their disaappointment they find a female working there as the store supervisor. Vasant gets hit by a big ball and falls unconcious. Meanwhile, back in the colony a big quarrel between Bhavna and Bhairavi breaks out.

videos.title: Vasant In Trouble
videos.overview: With great difficulty Varsha and Hemant  manage to take Vasant back home. Vasant has been speaking in alien language!  Bhavna and Bhairavi continue with their quarrel with no end in sight. Bhavna thinks only Vasant has a solution to their problem.  But Varsha discovers that Vasant has lost his memory.

videos.title: Vasant's Memory Loss
videos.overview: By mistake Hemant downloads Bhojpuri language into Vasant's system.  Vasant starts speaking in Bhojpuri. Varsha tries to help Vasant to recollect everything by showcasing their super power.  Finally Varsha tries to hit him with a ball which accidently hits Bhavna and she falls unconcious.

videos.title: Vasant's Language Changed
videos.overview: In this episode, Ronnie takes Vasant with him to Bhavna's house with the intention of helping him to find back his memory. Pritesh now finds an oppurtunity in it and starts interrogating Vasant in a peculiar manner which creates a matter of worry for Varsha and Shishir.

videos.title: Alien or Human Being

Meanwhile, Vasant comes up with the idea to disguise himself as a beggar. Who will win this challenge and be known as the superior actor? Will Vasant be succesful in his pursuit of the role of Draupadi?

videos.title: Draupadi is Missing

But as usual, things go wrong, and the performance is ruined by mistakes and several things going-most notably when the actor playing Draupadi goes missing. Will the audience still be entertained despite all the mistakes? And will they find Draupadi? Or will this performance go down as a failure? Watch this episode to find out now?

videos.title: Cancellation Of House Agreement
videos.overview: Vasant and the rest of the family receive a legal notice from their landlord. To their horror, the notice informs them that they will soon be evicted after failing to pay the rent for their house for 3 entire months. Vasant rushes to find the money worth the 3 months of unpaid rent in cash from somewhere. Will he be able to save the day? Or will mistakes once again get in the way, and this time lead to the family losing their home?

videos.title: Missing Vasant
videos.overview: Everyone at the colony is very worried, because Vasant is yet to return home after leaving to find the rent money. It is now late into the night, and they are yet to see or even hear from Vasant? What could have happened? Did something go wrong, and did the usual blunders and mishappenings land him in a sticky situation? Where is Vasant? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Missing Vasant
videos.overview: Ronnie arrives at the colony and informs everyone that the money has been paid to the landlord, but that he too has not seen Vasant. Meanwhile, Manav informs everyone that BAIR agents have caught an alien at Borivali. He and Varsha head to the BAIR bureau to confirm whether the caught alien is Vasant or not. Is this alien Vasant? And if it is not, who is this other alien? And will the family finally find Vasant, or is he still lost? Watch this espidoe tot find out now.

videos.title: Varsha In Bair Office
videos.overview: Varsha is glad to learn that the alien caught by the BAIR is not Vasant. But she also discovers that there was a two-headed alien caught by the agents very recently, which has now died. She panics and presumes that the body belongs to her lost son, '2015'. Meanwhile, the BAIR agents warn the residents fo the Sunshine Colony, saying that if the BAIR agency finds any evidence that suggests that the residents have been helping aliens, they will be in big trouble. Who is the lost alien, then?

videos.title: Vasant Goes Missing
videos.overview: The Sunshine Colony residents are worried about having to safeguard themselves from the BAIR agents after they receive a warning from them for helping aliens. Meanwhile, Varsha decides to flee from the colony, but leaves behind a message in a chit for Vasant, which tells him to reach a temple, where the rest of his alien family will be waiting for him. Will Vasant be reunited with Varsha and his family? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Hemanth's Letter For Vasant
videos.overview: All the residents of the Sunshine Colony arrive at the temple to find Varsha and her family after they discover the chit she left behind for Vasant. Meanwhile, Padmavati Devi and Mitesh get the BAIR agents arrested by the police. And in a third plot, Vasant reaches the Sunshine Colony, where he meets Bhadresh and Ramdulari. Will the family finally be reunited with Vasant with the help of the Sunshine Colony? And what will happen to the BAIR agents? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Vasant Ka Jhoot

Everyone asks Vasant where he was, since he had disappeared for a long time, but Vasant gives them a strange answer, listing all the possible reasons he could have gone missing, making all the residents of the Sunshine Colony confused, as they begin to get angry with Vasant for not giving them any clarity on where was he last night. Will they get to the bottom of this mystery?

videos.title: Vasant's Second Marriage
videos.overview: Vasant is behaving very secretively, and Hemant is very curious as to why. He begins to investigate and finally finds out the reason behind Vasant's behaviour. As it turns out, Vasant has married someone else and now has a second wife! All the Sunshine Colony members now go and ask Vasant for the truth about where he was when he went missing, when a lady who calls herself Premlata, or 'Premi' arrives at the colony and asks for Vasant. Is she Vasant's second wife? And why did he marry her?

videos.title: Vasant Ki Dusri Shaadi
videos.overview: Premi arrives at the Ghotala household, and Vasant finally admits in public that he has married her. Varsha is furious and is not ready to listen a single word in Vasant's defence. She gets very mad at Premlata and asks her to leave the house immediately. Why would Vasant marry for a second time? And why would his second wife be so eager to meet his other family? Could there be more to the story? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Vasant Ki Uljhan
videos.overview: All the colony members want an answer from Vasant, about who this Premlata is. They demand to know if he has married, and if so, why? Vasant tells Varsha how he came across Premlata and her father, and how he signed for them what he thought were papers of rent, but which turned out to be the papers of court marriage. How will Varsha and the others react to this mistake? Will this be the last straw, or will they get Vasant out of this hole too? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Vasant Ki Gharwali

Varsha, Sharad, and Hemant ask Vasant where was, to which he replies saying that he had gone where the High Command had sent him. They ask the High Command for more information, but High Command denies having sent Vasant anywhere. Where was he, then? And will Ojha and the others find out more about Premi?

Premi states in front of all the residents that she and Vasant have been married to each other for a long time and that Vasant even has written love letters to her. Varsha is shocked to hear this, but so is Vasant, as he is completely unaware of having done the things Premi is saying he did. Is she lying? And if so, why?

Still, Vasant denies having met Premi before. It is decided in the meeting that until Vasant's claims are proven or disproven, Premi gets to stay at the Ghotalas' house. Bhavna warns Varsha that now she has to take extra care of Vasant. What happens next?

videos.title: Biwiyo Ki Paheli
videos.overview: The ladies of the colony come up with a plan to find out the truth about Premlata. Could this be the answer, did Vasant's doppelganger cause this?

videos.title: Searching Vasant's Duplicate

Will this get in the way of the residents' plans? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Vasant As Professor Premi

Watch this episode to find out.

Is Premlata is not a fraud, and is Vasant lying to them?

videos.title: Searching Premlata's Husband In Chunkypur

What happens next?

What happens next?

Watch this episode to find out.

Will this nightmare finally end for the Ghotalas and the residents of the Sunshine Colony?

Meanwhile, back at the colony Lajo falls unconscious and Manav rushes her to the hospital using his super powers. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Murlidhar Knows Manav's Truth

Ojha reveals his displeasure upon learning that Manav is an alien. Will Ojha stay angry or forgive him? What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: 313 Holds 2015 Captive

Meanwhile, Sharad contacts Manav and asks for his help. Will Manav be able to help the family?

videos.title: Vasant Agrees to Repair Supernatural Device
videos.overview: A fight takes place between the aliens and the Ghotalas and Manav win, defeating 1313 and his cronies. The long wait finally ends and 2015 is reunited with his family. Watch this episode to find out now.

Will 1313 find out and stop him, or will Vasant be able to save the day? Watch this episode to find out now.

videos.title: Vasant's Advice to 2015
videos.overview: Vasant, disguised as Ila, lures 1313 away by dancing in front of him. But 1313 is hard to fool, and he catches Vasant. He warns him not to try and outsmart him again, and to repair the machine. Vasant tries to contact Sharad for help, but Sharad is unable to answer the call, as Sweety Singh has arrived at the colony o arrest 2015, whom he thinks is the nephew of a fraudulent conman the police is after. What happens next?

videos.title: Vasant As Ila Mehta

Watch this episode to find out.
